Performed sets and actual reps count, including sets below target. Records with no performed sets are excluded from the workout count. A set meets its target when actual reps reach the target. Volume = weight × actual reps. Bodyweight sets and reps still count. Duration includes rest and time outside the app. Weeks run Monday–Sunday in your local time zone, based on workout finish time. Editing or deleting history recalculates reports.
Workout records stay on this device with no account or cloud sync. Only when you send a prompt in AI Coach are your local training summary and profile sent to Zhipu GLM.

Hi! I am **FitPlan AI Fitness Coach**.

I read your local workout history, 8-week summary, recent set logs, daily check-ins, and training profile to provide grounded, evidence-based guidance.

- Tap a quick prompt above or type your own question below.
- Chat history stays in memory only and clears when you leave this tab or close the app.
Ask about your training, plan, or recovery…
Thinking and analyzing your local training data…
When sent, your training summary and profile are sent to Zhipu GLM. Advice is informational and does not replace medical or coaching care.

To generate personalized advice, this app sends your locally computed training summary, recent logs, check-ins, and training profile to Zhipu BigModel (GLM API).

• Advice is for reference only and does not replace medical care.
• Chat history stays in memory only and clears when you leave.
